title: Apostate
description: Place Bounties, Make Contracts, and More!
body:
# Welcome to "Apostate"!
Apostate is a small mod adding various features for Apostasy SMP Season Two.

## Bounties
- To place a Bounty on another player, you have to aquire Parchment [Currently obtained through breaking Sugar Cane]. You can craft Parchment into either a Bounty Poster or a Contract.
- Once you have a basic Bounty Poster, put it in an anvil and rename the poster to the desired players name [Capital Sensitive].
- After that, Shift click the bounty to set it in stone!
- NOTE: You can right click a bounty while its in your inventory to shift between "Wanted Dead", "Wanted Alive", and "Wanted Dead or Alive".

- If you make a "Wanted Alive" bounty, only the player who set that bounty is able to mark it as complete. "Wanted Dead" bounties auto complete.

## Completing Bounties
- Completing "Wanted Dead" Bounties: To complete a Bounty of a player whos wanted dead, you must kill the desired player while having the poster in your inventory. Once thats done, itll be marked as complete.
- Completing "Wanted Alive" Bounties: You can bring the poster to the person who set the bounty, and they can shift click it to mark it as completed.
- Completing "Wanted Dead or Alive" Bounties: You can do either of the above to have this type of bounty completed.
- NOTE: Only the person who set the bounty can mark it as complete for "Wanted Alive" and the alive option for "Wanted Dead or Alive"!!

## Contracts
- Can be signed by two people, a bearer and signer. Upon being completed, will become a fully signed contract for lore.
[Contract Recipe is soon to change!]

## Interactions
- By placing a "Bounty" inside an item frame, it will display differently! Instead it will show a visual of the type of bounty, and looking at it will show a tooltip of the details!
